+++ b/app/services/filter_users.py
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+import ast
+from app.db import store
+
+ALLOWED_NAMES = {'id', 'name', 'email'}
+ALLOWED_OPS = {
+    ast.Eq: "==", ast.NotEq: "!=", ast.Lt: "<",
+    ast.LtE: "<=", ast.Gt: ">", ast.GtE: ">="
+}
+
+def validate_node(node):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        if len(node.ops) != 1: return False
+        if not isinstance(node.left, ast.Name) or node.left.id not in ALLOWED_NAMES:
+            return False
+        if type(node.ops[0]) not in ALLOWED_OPS:
+            return False
+        if not isinstance(node.comparators[0], ast.Constant):
+            return False
+        return True
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        return all(validate_node(v) for v in node.values)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return validate_node(node.operand)
+        return False
+    return False
+
+def evaluate(node, user):
+    if isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+        left_val = user.get(node.left.id)
+        right_val = node.comparators[0].value
+        op = type(node.ops[0])
+        
+        if op == ast.Eq: return left_val == right_val
+        if op == ast.NotEq: return left_val != right_val
+        if op == ast.Lt: return left_val < right_val
+        if op == ast.LtE: return left_val <= right_val
+        if op == ast.Gt: return left_val > right_val
+        if op == ast.GtE: return left_val >= right_val
+        return False
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+            return all(evaluate(v, user) for v in node.values)
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+            return any(evaluate(v, user) for v in node.values)
+    elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
+        if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return not evaluate(node.operand, user)
+    return False
+
+def get_all_users():
+    return list(store._USERS.values())
+
+def filter_users(where_expr: str) -> list[dict] | None:
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(where_expr, mode='eval').body
+        if not validate_node(tree):
+            return None
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+        
+    all_users = get_all_users()
+    matched = []
+    for user in all_users:
+        if evaluate(tree, user):
+            matched.append(user)
+    return sorted(matched, key=lambda x: x['id'])

+from app.api.handlers import handle_filter_users
+
+def test_filter_users_ok():
+    code, res = handle_filter_users({"where": "name == 'Ada'"})
+    assert code == 200
+    assert res == {"users": [{"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}]}
